audits.ideal: The stack is boring for months at a time: a deliberate `butlers deploy` pins a SHA, migrates, recreates, verifies, and writes a deployments ledger row, so 'what is running' is a five-second verifiable fact and code/schema drift is structurally impossible rather than owner-gated toil; every infrastructure vital sign (connector liveness, backup recency and verified-restorability, butler heartbeats, disk, firewall state, schema drift) is a discovery source for the QA staffer — the system-wide SRE its manifesto already claims — flowing through triage into the attention ledger so the owner's phone buzzes within an hour of a feeder dying instead of an audit seven weeks later; an external deadman switch on another host covers the one failure no in-stack watcher can (total host death); the one Postgres holding the owner's life is dumped daily, copied offsite to the Garage/S3 already in the topology, and restore-drilled weekly with the result shown as a dated fact, never a fabricated green; and a host reboot is a non-event that re-applies the firewall, brings up the prod profile, and leaves a one-line receipt in the attention ledger.

audits.jarvis_gap: Today the attention plumbing (ledger, quiet hours, coalescing, budgets, urgent bypass) is real, and the insight path nominally implements the vision's disengagement clause via a 14-day adaptive budget ratchet and auto-off — but the loop is fed by a corrupted signal (ANY accepted ingress from ANY sender within 60 minutes marks insights engaged, so with always-on email/WhatsApp/telegram-user-client connectors the engagement rate saturates and the ratchet practically never fires), the engagement rows are unattributable (no origin_butler/category) and deleted after 30 days, the notify() path — the bulk of proactive egress — has zero feedback of any kind, the attention ledger is write-only (its one reader helper has zero callers and no API surface reads the table), and the cheapest true engagement signals (telegram reactions, direct replies) are structurally invisible because getUpdates never subscribes to message_reaction and the sent message_id is discarded. Nothing measures whether what reached the owner was GOOD, and no signal flows back into scoring. The ideal is a closed loop: owner-attributed engagement events (reply, reaction, one-tap grade, dismissal) stored durably with attribution, consumed by per-origin/per-category scoring modulation and notify-intent budgets, audited by a bounded LLM quality pass, and surfaced to the owner as a weekly one-tap relevance digest that doubles as ground truth.

findings.title: Insight engagement signal is poisoned by non-owner ingress — the vision's disengagement ratchet cannot fire in practice
findings.detail: check_and_update_engagement marks ALL insight_engagement rows delivered in the last 60 minutes engaged=TRUE on EVERY accepted pipeline ingress, with no check that the message is owner-authored. The same pipeline ingests third-party telegram_user_client messages, inbound email, and WhatsApp traffic (core_tools/_switchboard.py:269 -> pipeline.process). With always-on connectors, some ingress almost always arrives within 60 minutes of an 08:00 delivery, so engagement_rate saturates toward 1.0; compute_effective_budget's reduction tiers (broker.py:375-424) and the 14-day auto-off (broker.py:610-690) are dead code in practice. vision.md:136 ('automatically reduce frequency when the owner disengages') is nominally implemented but behaviorally inert. RFC 0011:282 specified 'a user message arriving on any channel' — even that intent predates connectors ingesting non-owner traffic through the same path.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py:1837-1851 (unconditional call, no sender check); roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py:512-562; src/butlers/core_tools/_switchboard.py:269; about/legends-and-lore/rfcs/0011-proactive-insight-delivery.md:282,374

findings.title: Attention ledger is write-only: zero readers, dead reader helper, no owner door
findings.detail: public.attention_ledger is written at every egress decision point, but nothing consumes it: count_attention_events_since has zero callers anywhere in src/, roster/, or tests (grep returned nothing outside attention_ledger.py itself), and no API router touches attention_ledger. Budgets and scoring never read it; the owner cannot see it. Violates both the engineering bar (dead helper shipped with no consumer) and the doctrine bar ('every clause a door') — the record of everything that claimed the owner's attention has no surface and no feedback role.
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'count_attention_events_since' src roster tests | grep -v attention_ledger.py -> empty; grep -rn 'attention_ledger' src/butlers/api -> empty; src/butlers/core/attention_ledger.py:197-245

findings.title: Engagement data is unattributable and destroyed after 30 days — the RFC's own precondition for learning is impossible
findings.detail: insight_engagement stores only (insight_id, delivered_at, engaged) with no origin_butler/category/priority denormalization (broker.py:111-117); attribution requires joining insight_candidates, but cleanup_old_rows deletes non-pending candidates AND engagement rows older than 30 days (broker.py:565-601), leaving dangling insight_ids and at most a 30-day unattributed boolean history. RFC 0011:394 explicitly deferred per-butler budget caps pending 'monitor engagement data per origin butler' and RFC 0011:390 deferred LLM re-ranking pending 'engagement data reveals systematic priority mis-calibration' — both monitoring tasks are structurally impossible with this schema and retention. No aggregate/rollup survives the purge.
findings.evidence: roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py:111-117,565-601; about/legends-and-lore/rfcs/0011-proactive-insight-delivery.md:390-394

findings.title: Owner reactions and replies are structurally invisible: no message_reaction subscription, sent message_id discarded
findings.detail: Three gaps compound: (1) the telegram bot connector's getUpdates passes only timeout+offset — no allowed_updates — so Telegram never delivers message_reaction updates (they are excluded by default); the owner tapping thumbs-up/down on a butler message is unobservable. (2) _send_message returns the full Telegram response including result.message_id, but the notify chain discards it — the notifications table has no provider message_id column (INSERT at log.py:62 covers source_butler/channel/recipient/message/metadata/status/error/session_id/trace_id only), despite the Messenger manifesto mandating outcome reporting 'with delivery identifiers when available'. (3) Inbound reply_to_message is not parsed anywhere in telegram_bot.py or pipeline.py, so a direct reply to a specific insight cannot be correlated to it. Together these forfeit the cheapest, highest-precision engagement signals a one-person system can get.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/connectors/telegram_bot.py:547-556 (params = timeout+offset only); src/butlers/modules/telegram.py:345-402 (response data returned, message_id never persisted); roster/switchboard/tools/notification/log.py:61-79 (no message_id column); grep -rn 'reply_to_message' connectors/telegram_bot.py modules/pipeline.py -> no inbound handling; roster/messenger/MANIFESTO.md 'Outcome reporting'

findings.title: notify() path — the majority of proactive egress — has no engagement tracking or adaptation at all
findings.detail: Engagement rows exist only for insight-broker deliveries (record_engagement_rows called solely from delivery_cycle Step 9). Every scheduled-task notify() (weekly health summary, relationship reconnect suggestions, finance crons, chronicler digests) is recorded in the attention ledger and the notifications table but generates no engagement row, no per-intent statistics, and feeds nothing back. A butler whose weekly digest the owner never reads will send it forever at the same cadence; the one-way ratchet the spec mandates (proactive-insight-engine spec.md:114) covers only the thin insight-candidate slice of owner-facing traffic.
findings.evidence: roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py:490-509 (only caller path is delivery_cycle:1040); grep 'insight_engagement' across src/ shows no notify-path writer; openspec/specs/proactive-insight-engine/spec.md:114-124 scopes tracking to delivered insight candidates only

moves.title: Owner-attributed engagement events: replace the boolean insight_engagement with public.engagement_events and gate the 60-minute proxy on owner identity
moves.why: vision.md:136 requires frequency reduction on owner disengagement; today's signal measures connector traffic, not the owner (finding 1). Attribution + durability is the precondition RFC 0011:390-394 set for every deferred learning feature. Serves the Switchboard manifesto (ingress ownership / arbitration).
moves.slice_plan: 1) Migration: public.engagement_events (ref_type insight|notification, ref_id, origin_butler, category, priority_score, delivered_at, signal owner_message_60m|reply|reaction|grade_up|grade_down|dismissed, observed_at) + daily rollup table that survives the 30-day purge. 2) In pipeline.py's engagement hook, resolve source_sender_identity against the owner contact (same relationship.entity_facts resolver ingress routing already uses) and only write owner_message_60m events for owner-authored messages. 3) Rewrite compute_effective_budget + auto-off to read engagement_events with attribution; drop insight_engagement entirely (compat waived). 4) Spec deltas: proactive-insight-engine + insight-delivery scenarios; RFC 0011 Amendment 2.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py:1837-1851; roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py (compute_effective_budget, record_engagement_rows, cleanup_old_rows, check_total_disengagement_auto_off); new core alembic migration; openspec/specs/proactive-insight-engine/spec.md:114-152; openspec/specs/insight-delivery/spec.md:53-61; rfcs/0011 amendment

moves.title: Telegram reaction + reply capture as first-class engagement signals
moves.why: Finding 4: the cheapest true-positive engagement channel (owner taps a reaction or replies to the exact message) is invisible today. Messenger manifesto already mandates delivery identifiers; this completes that clause into a loop. Distinct from bu-24lu6 (approve/reject decision callbacks) but reuses its .5 callback-ingestion plumbing.
moves.slice_plan: 1) Add allowed_updates=[message, message_reaction] to telegram_bot getUpdates and parse message_reaction updates into engagement_events (owner-filtered). 2) Persist sent provider message_id: add message_id column to public.notifications, thread _send_message's response.result.message_id back through the messenger deliver chain and notify(); stamp it on the attention-ledger row's notification_ref and insight metadata. 3) Parse inbound reply_to_message and correlate to the referenced notification -> engagement_events(signal=reply). 4) Map thumbs-up/heart -> grade_up, thumbs-down -> grade_down on the correlated insight/notification.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/connectors/telegram_bot.py:547-556 (_get_updates), update parsing; src/butlers/modules/telegram.py:345-402; roster/switchboard/tools/notification/log.py + deliver.py; src/butlers/core_tools/_notifications.py; migration adding notifications.message_id; reuses bu-24lu6.5 callback ingestion; openspec/specs/core-notify delta

moves.title: Close the loop into scoring: per-origin/per-category engagement modulation and notify-intent cadence demotion
moves.why: This is the feedback loop the pursuit question demands and the exact follow-up RFC 0011:390-394 gated on data: today engagement only shrinks a global budget count, never WHICH insights win or which notify() intents keep firing (findings 3, 5). Serves vision.md:136 and every proposing butler's manifesto by rewarding butlers whose insights the owner actually engages.
moves.slice_plan: 1) Nightly job computes Laplace-smoothed engagement rate per (origin_butler, category) from engagement_events rollups (45-day window). 2) delivery_cycle Step 6 applies a bounded multiplier to priority for routine (sub-urgent) candidates — urgent bypass untouched. 3) notify() path: per (origin_butler, intent) rates below a floor demote that intent's routine sends to the existing coalescing/digest path instead of standalone delivery; ledger reason records 'demoted:low_engagement' so nothing is silently dropped. 4) One-way ratchet preserved: modulation only demotes; restoration is an explicit owner action on the dashboard.
moves.integration_points: roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py Step 5/6; src/butlers/core_tools/_notifications.py coalescing branch; src/butlers/core/attention_ledger.py (reason vocabulary); new switchboard scheduled job in roster/switchboard/butler.toml; spec delta proactive-insight-engine (new Adaptive Scoring requirement); RFC 0011 amendment

moves.title: Weekly one-tap relevance digest: the owner grades last week's proactive traffic in one message
moves.why: The pursuit question asks for owner-graded ground truth; no surface exists (finding 2 — ledger has no door). A weekly Telegram digest listing every delivered/coalesced item with per-item useful/noise inline keyboards is the highest-signal, lowest-friction measurement instrument, and doubles as the owner-visible attention-ledger door the doctrine requires. Serves Switchboard (arbitration) + Messenger (delivery) manifestos.
moves.slice_plan: 1) Weekly switchboard scheduled job reads attention_ledger (delivered+coalesced, last 7 days), composes a compact digest. 2) Reuse bu-24lu6.4 inline-keyboard + .5 callback-ingestion infra for one-tap grades; grades write engagement_events(grade_up/grade_down) with full attribution. 3) Dashboard counterpart: an Attention section (notifications page or new /attention) rendering ledger outcomes + engagement rates per butler, wiring or deleting the dead count_attention_events_since. 4) Digest itself is exempt from grading recursion and recorded in the ledger like any egress.
moves.integration_points: roster/switchboard/butler.toml (new scheduled job); roster/switchboard/tools/ (digest composer); public.attention_ledger reader + new API router endpoint under src/butlers/api/routers/; frontend notifications page; bu-24lu6.4/.5 keyboard+callback infra (reuse, not duplicate); openspec new capability spec attention-ledger

moves.title: Bounded LLM insight-quality audit: daily labeling pass that detects priority mis-calibration per origin butler
moves.why: RFC 0011:390 rejected LLM re-ranking 'deferred to a follow-up if engagement data reveals systematic priority mis-calibration' — but nothing can reveal it (finding 3). An evaluation-only (never gating) judge closes that: it measures whether delivered insights were timely/actionable/non-duplicative and whether high-priority claims were honest. Mirrors the shipped chronicler once-daily bounded LLM labeling pattern, so cost and doctrine posture (no LLM in the delivery path) are proven.
moves.slice_plan: 1) Once-daily bounded job (cap N=20 items) sends yesterday's delivered insights + their engagement outcomes + expiry/action status to a cheap-tier model via the existing model_routing complexity tiers; writes quality_score + failure tags (stale, duplicate-of-memory, unactionable, priority-inflated) into insight metadata and a per-butler calibration rollup. 2) Surface calibration rows on the dashboard attention section (move 4). 3) When a butler's inflation rate crosses a threshold, propose (never auto-apply) a priority-band correction as an owner approval — feeding the existing approvals surface.
moves.integration_points: new src/butlers/jobs/ insight_quality.py scheduled from roster/switchboard/butler.toml; src/butlers/core/model_routing.py resolve_model for tier; insight_candidates.metadata + new rollup table; dashboard attention section; spend purpose-tag (purpose='insight-quality-audit') via the shipped purpose-tagged spend

moves.title: Durable attention rollups: stop destroying the learning substrate at 30 days
moves.why: Finding 3: cleanup_old_rows purges the only engagement history at 30 days, so any learning loop starves on cold start after every quiet month. th-engineering bar: also resolves the dead count_attention_events_since (wire it into the rollup job or delete it). Small, unblocks moves 3-5.
moves.slice_plan: 1) Migration: public.attention_daily_rollup (day, origin_butler, category/intent, delivered, coalesced, suppressed, engaged, graded_up, graded_down). 2) Extend the daily delivery cycle's cleanup step to upsert rollups before deleting raw rows; retention on raw rows stays 30d, rollups keep 2y. 3) Delete count_attention_events_since or repoint it at the rollup table with an actual caller.
moves.integration_points: roster/switchboard/tools/insight/broker.py cleanup_old_rows; src/butlers/core/attention_ledger.py:197-245; new core migration; consumed by moves 3 (modulation window), 4 (digest), 5 (calibration)

findings.title: memory_catalog lifecycle is insert-only: retracted/expired/consolidation-superseded facts keep surfacing fleet-wide
findings.detail: Cross-butler search excludes stale rows solely via 'invalid_at IS NULL' (search.py:825,866), but invalid_at is set in exactly ONE place: _mark_catalog_stale is called only from the direct-write supersession path inside the 'if enable_shared_catalog and source_schema' guard (storage.py:1622). (a) forget_memory / memory_forget never touches the catalog (storage.py:1944-2018, tools/management.py:17-58); (b) run_decay_sweep sets validity='expired' with a bare UPDATE and no catalog cascade (storage.py:2595-2617); (c) consolidation_executor calls store_fact WITHOUT enable_shared_catalog/source_schema (consolidation_executor.py:110-124, 150-162), so consolidation-driven supersession skips the stale-mark while the 5-min backfill job (memory/__init__.py:86-90) later inserts the NEW fact — both versions of the truth then surface simultaneously; (d) purge_superseded_facts hard-DELETEs canonical rows (storage.py:2707-2712) leaving live orphan catalog rows; backfill is insert-only with no reverse reconciliation (storage.py:510-555). Net effect: an owner-approved retraction of a WRONG fact (the documented 'has a son' mis-extraction) continues to be served to every butler and to GET /api/memory/catalog/search indefinitely — failure impersonating health at the data layer.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/search.py:825,866; src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:1622 (grep '_mark_catalog_stale' → single caller), 2595-2617, 2707-2712, 510-555; src/butlers/modules/memory/consolidation_executor.py:110-124; src/butlers/modules/memory/tools/management.py:17-58

findings.title: Fact provenance is designed to sever within 7 days — no fact can durably answer 'where did you learn this'
findings.detail: Runtime-session fact writes get provenance via a synthetic placeholder episode ('[runtime session provenance placeholder]') created with retention_class='transient' and expires_at = now + 7 days (storage.py:820-843). run_episode_cleanup unconditionally deletes expired episodes (consolidation.py:490), and facts.source_episode_id is 'REFERENCES episodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL' (memory/migrations/001_memory_schema.py:118,302) — so the fact→episode→session chain is nulled out within a week by design. request_id is captured only if the LLM volunteers a request_context dict (tools/writing.py:273-288; __init__.py tool description says 'When omitted... no request_id'). Bonus defects: placeholder episodes default to consolidation_status='pending' so they enter the LLM consolidation batch as junk content, and each one burns an embedding of a constant string (storage.py:823). This breaks the trace-spine bar (signal→session→audit→root evidence) for the entire fact store.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:56,785-843; src/butlers/modules/memory/consolidation.py:490; src/butlers/modules/memory/migrations/001_memory_schema.py:118,302; src/butlers/modules/memory/tools/writing.py:273-288

findings.title: Confidence is still hardcoded 1.0 at every memory-fact write; consolidation emits no confidence signal at all
findings.detail: store_fact inserts confidence literal 1.0 (storage.py:961) and the catalog write-behind stamps confidence=1.0 (storage.py:1606); grep for 'confidence' across consolidation_parser.py, consolidation_executor.py, prompt_template.py returns nothing — the extraction LLM is never asked for certainty. Consequences: 'effective confidence' (confidence * exp(-decay_rate*days), storage.py:2585) is a pure recency proxy; the retrieval score term 0.1*effective_confidence (docs/modules/memory.md:105) differentiates nothing at write time; and relationship's low-confidence review sweep pattern (threshold 0.6, relationship_jobs.py:2307) is structurally impossible to port to memory-module stores because no row can ever be below 1.0. Only rules get a differentiated start (0.5, storage.py:1675). The known shape has NOT changed.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:961,1606,1675,2585; grep -n confidence consolidation_parser.py consolidation_executor.py prompt_template.py → empty; roster/relationship/jobs/relationship_jobs.py:2307

findings.title: No cross-butler contradiction detection despite memory_catalog now exposing (entity_id, predicate) fleet-wide
findings.detail: The only contradiction sweep in the system is relationship-schema-local: run_fact_retraction_curation scans relationship.facts only, gated to a 10-predicate hardcoded allowlist (_CONTRADICTION_FUNCTIONAL_PREDICATES, relationship_jobs.py:2335-2348). Memory-module supersession is keyed per-schema on (entity_id, scope, predicate), so health and general can hold divergent active values for the same functional predicate about the same entity indefinitely, and both now surface side-by-side in catalog search — the catalog has entity_id, predicate, source_schema, summary columns (core_009_memory_catalog.py:132-172) that make a deterministic cross-schema disagreement sweep a straightforward GROUP BY, but nothing runs it. grep 'contradiction' in openspec/specs shows only relationship-curation/spec.md; no memory-catalog contradiction requirement exists.
findings.evidence: roster/relationship/jobs/relationship_jobs.py:2335-2348,2363-2401; alembic/versions/core/core_009_memory_catalog.py:132-177; grep -rn contradiction openspec/specs → relationship-curation only

findings.title: Sensitivity/PII taxonomy is vacuous and there is no right-to-forget cascade
findings.detail: facts.sensitivity defaults to 'normal' at every write path (memory/__init__.py:849 'sensitivity or "normal"'), the consolidate SKILL.md never mentions it, and no roster CLAUDE.md or skill instructs any butler to classify pii/confidential — so the catalog's max_sensitivity authorization model (search.py:780-810) and the sensitivity partial index gate nothing in practice. Meanwhile docs/operations/data-retention.md declares public.ingestion_events (full raw payloads incl. third-party message content) KEEP FOREVER, retention pruners ship disabled-by-default and no butler.toml enables them (grep 'prune|retention' roster/*/butler.toml → only unrelated hits), and forget_memory is a per-item soft-retract that leaves content in the DB ('The memory remains in the database', storage.py:1960) with no cascade from entity/event → facts → episodes → catalog → raw payloads. Owner sovereignty includes the right to forget; today there is no door that exercises it.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/__init__.py:849; src/butlers/modules/memory/search.py:780-810; docs/operations/data-retention.md ('KEEP FOREVER' for ingestion_events); src/butlers/jobs/retention.py:8-12; grep sensitivity roster/*/CLAUDE.md roster/*/.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md → only finance anomaly_scan (unrelated)

findings.title: Staleness handling is silent decay with no re-confirmation loop and no per-predicate SLA
findings.detail: run_decay_sweep's terminal actions are metadata.status='fading' and validity='expired' — both silent DB flags (storage.py:2618-2625, 2595-2617); no insight candidate, notification, or owner re-confirmation is ever generated. For trust-critical categories (address, allergy, medication) silent expiry is data loss; for volatile ones silent retention is staleness. Permanence (the only decay lever, _PERMANENCE_DECAY storage.py:61-67) is chosen ad hoc by the writing LLM per call; there is no predicate→permanence/verify-after registry, so the same predicate can decay at 5 different rates depending on which session wrote it. memory_confirm exists (feedback.py:17) but nothing drives it proactively.
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:61-67,2595-2633; src/butlers/modules/memory/tools/feedback.py:17-30; docs/modules/memory.md:57-58

findings.title: Entity dedup runs only as a weekly O(n^2) canonical-name Levenshtein scan; nothing corroborates and nothing guards at create time
findings.detail: run_entity_dedup_curation fetches ALL entities and does pairwise Python Levenshtein on canonical_name only (relationship_jobs.py:2937-2947, 3010-3035) — aliases, embeddings, and shared contact_info are never consulted, names <5 chars are skipped entirely, and cost grows quadratically with the graph. entity_create's only guard is the exact (canonical_name, entity_type) unique constraint (entities.py:88-127), so 'Bob'/'Robert Smith' or 'Mum'/'Sarah Tan' duplicates are created freely and split facts across two graph nodes for up to a week before even being PROPOSED. Spec drift: relationship-curation/spec.md allows auto-merge of corroborated matches (shared contact_info/alias/edge), but the job never auto-merges and never computes corroboration.
findings.evidence: roster/relationship/jobs/relationship_jobs.py:2869-3035; src/butlers/modules/memory/tools/entities.py:88-127; openspec/specs/relationship-curation/spec.md ('Corroborated entity match is auto-merged')

audits.ideal: The data substrate a sovereign JARVIS can act on autonomously is one where every fact carries calibrated belief (confidence derived from how it was learned, not a constant), an unbreakable provenance chain (fact → session → signal, surviving all cleanup), and a lifecycle whose every transition — retraction, expiry, supersession, purge — propagates atomically to every index that serves it, so the fleet-wide catalog can never assert something its owning butler has disowned. Contradictions between butlers are detected mechanically the moment the shared catalog makes them visible, staleness is governed by per-predicate SLAs that trigger owner re-confirmation for critical categories rather than silent evaporation, entity identity is corroborated at write time so facts never split across duplicate nodes, and the owner holds a working right-to-forget: one command that walks an entity or event through facts, episodes, catalog rows, and raw payloads with a dry-run preview. The substrate stays trustworthy as it grows because honesty is structural — drift gauges, contradiction sweeps, and re-confirmation loops are scheduled deterministic jobs, not aspirations.
audits.jarvis_gap: Today the machinery exists but its trust invariants are broken: the just-enabled public.memory_catalog is effectively insert-only (retraction, decay expiry, consolidation supersession, and hard purges all leave live catalog rows, so disowned facts circulate fleet-wide forever); provenance is engineered to sever within 7 days via expiring placeholder episodes and ON DELETE SET NULL; confidence is still hardcoded 1.0 everywhere so decay is pure recency and low-confidence review is impossible; contradiction detection exists only inside relationship.facts behind a 10-predicate allowlist while the catalog exposes cross-butler disagreements nobody scans; sensitivity classification and the catalog's authorization gate are vacuous because nothing ever labels PII; staleness ends in silent flags rather than re-confirmation; and entity dedup is a weekly name-only O(n^2) scan with no create-time guard. The system can remember — it cannot yet be trusted to still be right, to say how it knows, or to genuinely forget.

moves.title: Catalog lifecycle parity: every fact-lifecycle transition cascades to memory_catalog, plus a drift gauge
moves.why: Vision's earned-calm bar ('failure never impersonates health') and the fleet honest-aggregation convention: a retracted falsehood served to all 9 butlers via catalog search is fabricated truth. Payoff: cross-butler search and the fleet-knowledge dashboard become safe to act on autonomously.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py (call _mark_catalog_stale from forget_memory, run_decay_sweep, rule-forget, purge_superseded_facts); consolidation_executor.py store_fact calls gain enable_shared_catalog/source_schema; run_memory_catalog_backfill gains a reverse-reconciliation batch (stale-mark catalog rows whose canonical row is missing/non-active); memory_stats + GET /api/memory/stats meta gains a catalog_drift count; spec delta in openspec/specs/memory-discovery-catalog. Serves all memory-hosting butler manifestos (memory is a module, not a butler).
moves.slice_plan: 1) wire _mark_catalog_stale into forget/decay/purge with unit tests; 2) fix consolidation_executor pass-through; 3) reverse reconciliation in backfill job; 4) drift gauge in stats API + dashboard chip.

moves.title: Durable provenance ledger: first-class source_session_id/learned_via on facts, retire the expiring placeholder-episode hack
moves.why: Doctrine's trace spine ('every clause a door on an unbroken trace: signal → session → audit → root evidence') is currently severed by design within 7 days at the fact layer. Payoff: every fact answers 'where did you learn this' forever, and the fact-detail dossier gets a real door to the originating session.
moves.integration_points: New core alembic migration adding facts.source_session_id UUID, facts.learned_via TEXT (owner_stated|consolidation|connector|curation), facts.source_event_id; storage.py _resolve_write_provenance_with_conn replaced with direct column writes from get_current_runtime_session_id()/routing context (delete _RUNTIME_PROVENANCE_PLACEHOLDER machinery — compat waived); memory_catalog gains the same columns; frontend fact dossier links to /sessions/{id}. Serves the single-pane operator-console doctrine (docs/frontend/purpose-and-single-pane.md).
moves.slice_plan: 1) migration + write-path columns; 2) delete placeholder-episode machinery + its consolidation-junk side effect; 3) backfill learned_via for consolidation facts from memory_links; 4) dossier door in frontend.

moves.title: Provenance-derived confidence calibration at write time
moves.why: Vision: 'trusted with real decisions' requires calibrated belief; with conf=1.0 everywhere, decay is a recency timer and the 0.1*confidence retrieval weight is a no-op. Payoff: low-confidence review sweeps (already proven in relationship) become possible across all memory stores, and autonomy gates can require confidence floors.
moves.integration_points: storage.py store_fact gains a confidence param defaulted from learned_via (owner_stated 1.0, consolidation 0.8, connector 0.6, curation 0.5) — depends on the learned_via column from the provenance move; consolidation prompt_template.py + consolidation_parser.py emit/validate per-fact confidence; memory_confirm bumps toward 1.0; a fleet low-confidence review job generalizing relationship_jobs.py's 0.6-threshold scan into src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py. Spec delta in module-memory spec.
moves.slice_plan: 1) write-path defaults keyed on learned_via; 2) consolidation prompt/parser emit confidence; 3) memory_confirm bump semantics; 4) fleet low-confidence sweep surfacing insight candidates.

moves.title: Cross-butler contradiction sweep over memory_catalog with a shared functional-predicate registry
moves.why: The pursuit's core question: the catalog just made cross-butler facts visible, and nothing exploits it. Payoff: 'health says owner is vegetarian, general says owner ordered steak weekly' gets surfaced as an owner decision instead of silently steering two butlers in opposite directions.
moves.integration_points: New deterministic scheduled job (switchboard or the butler hosting the sweep — src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py) grouping active catalog rows by (entity_id, predicate) across distinct source_schema with differing summaries; promote relationship's _CONTRADICTION_FUNCTIONAL_PREDICATES allowlist to a public registry table (pattern: relationship.entity_predicate_registry) shared by both sweeps; disagreements emit insight candidates + pending_actions (owner-approval, mirroring RFC 0017 posture); new requirement in openspec/specs/memory-discovery-catalog. Serves switchboard's shared-situational-awareness mandate (roster/switchboard/MANIFESTO.md) — arguably implies a small manifesto amendment naming data-coherence stewardship.
moves.slice_plan: 1) registry table + seed from relationship allowlist; 2) catalog GROUP BY sweep job (deterministic, no LLM); 3) approvals/insight wiring; 4) spec delta.

moves.title: Right-to-forget cascade: owner-invoked purge of an entity/event across facts, episodes, catalog, and raw payloads
moves.why: Vision non-negotiable #1 (full sovereignty — the owner owns all data) implies the right to genuinely delete; today forget is per-item soft-retract and ingestion_events raw payloads are keep-forever with pruners disabled. Payoff: one command with dry-run preview that makes 'forget about X' true, not cosmetic.
moves.integration_points: New MCP tool + dashboard action (impact-aware destructive confirm pattern from secrets v2): walk entity_id via public.memory_catalog to all schemas' facts/episodes/memory_links, catalog rows, relationship.entity_facts, and optionally redact matching public.ingestion_events / connectors.filtered_events payloads (redaction column, preserving the audit row shell per data-retention.md's append-only posture); dry-run returns a counted manifest; audit_log records the purge. Amends docs/operations/data-retention.md and the memory-retention-policy spec.
moves.slice_plan: 1) dry-run manifest endpoint (read-only, ships value alone); 2) memory-layer cascade (facts/episodes/links/catalog); 3) raw-payload redaction with owner double-confirm; 4) audit + dashboard door.

moves.title: Staleness SLA registry + re-confirmation loop through the attention ledger
moves.why: Vision success marker: data 'maintained without manual entry' — silent expiry of an address or allergy fact is unmaintained data loss; the attention ledger (shipped 07-04) is the sanctioned egress for exactly this kind of low-urgency owner question. Payoff: critical facts get re-confirmed ('Is your address still X?') instead of evaporating; trivia still decays silently.
moves.integration_points: New public registry table predicate_staleness_policy (predicate → default permanence, verify_after_days, criticality); run_decay_sweep (storage.py:2595-2633) consults it and, for critical predicates entering 'fading', emits an insight candidate routed through the attention ledger/quiet-hours pipeline instead of expiring; owner confirmation calls memory_confirm (resets clock); writing.py uses the registry as the permanence default so LLM ad-hoc choice becomes an override, not the source of truth. Spec delta in module-memory + memory-retention-policy.

synthesis.headline: The 07-04 epic largely landed — five of its moves landed-as-designed and the QC squad source- or live-confirmed the primitives (DegradedSources, DispatchVerdict, one board verdict, one SessionDossier, URL doors, the event-cache registry) as real and multiply adopted — but its signature honesty work stopped one layer short of the pixels: three backend degraded flags ship with zero frontend readers, and the surfaces the sweep never reached (sessions, issues, calendar, ingestion connectors) still render outages as calm. The sharpest new findings are live production failures the console cannot see: the daily insight cycle is crashing on a cooldown pkey collision while its own ledger narrates the outage as quiet-hours discipline, the secrets lifecycle push has never once delivered, main's check job has been red since 07-06 on a calendar time-bomb test, and seven merged migrations sit undeployed leaving the attention ledger dark. The eleven new engineering/governance/ecosystem lenses move the frontier from pixels to plumbing — boundaries, reliability, and proactivity-quality all grade weak: upward core→api imports hide a cross-process event bus that structurally drops every daemon-originated event, and the engagement signal meant to drive the vision's disengagement ratchet is poisoned by connector noise. The ranked list accordingly mixes verticals as the owner asked: five UX honesty batches, four engineering spine fixes, three governance loops (decision desk, prompt unification, archive cadence), and three ecosystem arteries.
synthesis.qc_summary: Per the QC squad the epic is substantially real: qvnce.3 (memory lifecycle wiring), .4 (dashboard coherence on one board verdict), .5 (one SessionDossier), .11 (shortcut/palette/list-triage spine, broadly adopted), and .13 (URL-backed filters + predicate doors) landed-as-designed — several live-confirmed — and the seven-fabrication hotfix batch (.2) shipped six of seven items clean. Eight moves landed-with-gaps in one consistent shape: mechanism real, last mile missing. qvnce.1's tracker threads all seven routers yet memory pools_failed, spend daily/top-sessions/breakdown, and approvals sources_degraded have zero frontend readers; .2's isDown fix never reached IngestionTimelinePage, the badge's original home; .7 left a switchboard/lifestyle hue collision and an unfinished H1 flip; .9/.10's extraction origins (SystemVerdictBanner, ingestion EventDrawer) still run parallel hand-rolled copies while FloatingChatWidget ships role="dialog" with none of the choreography and the "axe sweep" added zero new coverage (31 of ~33 routes grandfathered); .14 orphaned three consumer-less backend WS routes and left notifications half-wired on the dual-channel liveness contract. The worst landings are ecosystem: .8's attention ledger is live but the insight delivery cycle is crashing in production (broker.py:483 pkey collision, live error 2026-07-10), the secrets lifecycle push has never delivered (deliver.py:455 bare butler_registry; 120 suppressed / 0 delivered rows) while benign-branch-only ledger writers misattribute the outage, and home's four crons bypass the boundary via raw Telegram POSTs; .12's API-direct lane sits disabled in the live catalog with no provenance; .15's dashboard-search consumer never landed; and bu-gxmfx's delegation ledger is zero-row machinery with no producers or readers. Nothing outright regressed, but the run's dominant lesson is that honesty flags and shared primitives can ship backend-only and still count as done.

Chronicles near-bar with three honesty holes (silent source-health swallow, vanishing badge strip, 500-event trail truncation); education is a pre-Dispatch Card page whose error state impersonates 'No curriculums yet' and whose teaching-flow machinery is invisible.

New critical: circuit-breaker reset fabricates a clean patrol + fake case that repaint the system healthy at its worst moment; case dossiers have no session doors; /system verdict is blind to the QA staffer.
Rich and mostly honest, except the 'failed' status (routing failures) is invisible across chips/ledger/errors-view/histogram and two surfaces assert a retry policy that exists nowhere in code.
No dedicated audit; entities audit flags silent 500-row truncation with page-local search.
Registries/palette/chords/help-sheet are world-class in design; 10 of 13 verb scopes still lack bindings, ingestion sub-routes re-orphaned, empty-query Actions starved by 13 Trigger commands.
Dispatch base layer genuinely flipped; app remains bilingual — solid badge fills in 13 files, ~165 wrong-value var() fallbacks, two type scales, focus contract implemented at 2 of ~104 sites.
All primitives built, each stopped at a beachhead: poll-policy lint covers 9 of ~30 files, prefetch maps 3 routes, no query adapts to bus health, memory registers flash false empties.

Verdict drop reflects deeper scrutiny: excellent infra (choreography, announcer, axe registry, contrast test) adopted in ~a third of the product — tr role=button tables, inaudible j/k triage, alert storms, frozen skip-manifest.
Hot paths are the least decomposed: spawner._run 1,408L, pipeline.process 1,395L, calendar.py 10,202L, types.ts/client.ts are the repo's top-two churn conflict magnets.
8,414 mostly-real tests with strong structural guards, but main red since 07-06 on a wall-clock time-bomb, 1,469 unit tests force-marked integration, and the FE/BE contract has zero drift check.

~25 upward core→api imports hide cycles, the fleet event bus structurally cannot cross the container boundary, framework imports roster via sys.modules injection, and un-RFC'd cross-schema writes exist.
Real cruft governance but no enforcement: ~3,000+ lines of orphaned FE code, duplicated passport atoms with tests pinning dead copies, dead WS routes, and shipped changes never archived.

Strong skeleton, broken high-traffic paths: quickstart starts a deleted postgres service, deployment map is pre-April, and butler CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md prompt bodies silently diverged so runtime behavior forks by CLI.
All five pillars exist and are strong; missing metabolism — AGENTS.md is a ~150-contract shadow spec layer, Source References is dead law (149/176 violate), no staleness machinery anywhere.

Per-change spec deltas are largely practiced, but the archive/sync last step lags, leaving core-notify/ingestion-policy/memory-discovery-catalog main specs materially false; classification fast lane and ApiAdapter shipped spec-less.

Vision markers SC-6/SC-8 are unmeasurable, v1-status is 12 days stale across the fastest fortnight ever, and 14 owner-decision beads have no cadence — decision latency now blocks a P1 fix and a 7-migration deploy.

Prod runs the dev hotreload profile with no deploy pipeline, every infra health signal is pull-only (connectors dead 7+ weeks unnoticed), backups hardcode status=success, reboot drops the egress firewall.
Attention plumbing is real but the engagement signal is poisoned by non-owner ingress (ratchet can never fire), the ledger is write-only, and notify()-path egress has zero feedback.

memory_catalog is effectively insert-only (retracted/expired facts circulate fleet-wide forever), provenance severs by design in 7 days, confidence is hardcoded 1.0, no cross-butler contradiction sweep.

themes.title: Honesty flags ship backend-only — emitted degraded signals with zero pixels listening
themes.body: The 07-04 epic's core contract — a failed source must never render as calm — was fulfilled by the backend and then abandoned at the wire on multiple surfaces. The DegradedSources tracker threads seven routers, but memory's pools_failed has zero frontend consumers (the /memory 'is remembering working' verdict renders confident totals over half-failed fan-outs), spend's daily/top-sessions/breakdown flags are dropped on the floor, approvals' sources_degraded is unread so 'No approvals waiting.' can render over a downed pool, notifications' source_available is consumed only by the verdict opener while the KPI tiles directly below show a green 0.0% during a total delivery-plane outage, and the timeline isDown fix stopped one page short of the badge's original home. A flag the backend emits with no reader is a new fabrication shape: honesty that counts as done without being seen.
themes.exemplars: src/butlers/api/routers/memory.py:308 (pools_failed, grep frontend → 0 hits); src/butlers/api/routers/spend.py:813,934,1163 vs frontend/src/pages/SpendPage.tsx:84-92; frontend/src/components/notifications/notification-stats-bar.tsx:24-27,113-123

themes.title: Error-as-empty second wave — surfaces never swept under the degraded convention render outages as calm
themes.body: Beyond unread flags, whole endpoint families never received the convention at all. All four sessions cross-butler reads use the silent fan_out that swallows pool failures ('No sessions failed in the last 24h' during an incident; pool-down 404s real sessions), /api/issues — the surface whose product is failure — returns [] on any exception and renders the all-clear empty state, and dozens of frontend queries never read isError: calendar's day briefing prints 'Tomorrow is clear' on a failed fetch, the connectors roster asserts 'No connectors registered' + all-zero KPI verdict on outage, health/entities/education blocks hide identically for empty and down. The fix is structural (one honest fan-out primitive + contract tests), not another artisanal sweep.

themes.title: Primitives built once, adoption frozen at the beachhead — and no ratchet forces the burn-down
themes.body: Every shared mechanism from the epics is real and excellent, and every one stalled: useModalChoreography has 4 adopters while FloatingChatWidget ships role=dialog with none of it (and its presence suspends all page shortcuts app-wide); the axe route sweep grandfathered 30 of 32 routes into a skip-manifest that has never lost an entry; poll-policy lint covers 9 files against ~97 raw refetchInterval sites; the prefetch registry maps 3 routes while its handlers are attached fleet-wide; useListTriage skips the board, timeline, audit, ingestion, and memory — the densest triage lists; useOptimisticMutation lives in 4 of ~90 mutation files; extraction origins (SystemVerdictBanner, ingestion EventDrawer) still run parallel hand-rolled copies of the contracts extracted from them. The taxonomy's new shape: a gate ships with ~100% of the surface exempted and the gate's existence is then cited as coverage. Every future primitive needs a born-with burn-down bead or a ratchet test.

themes.title: The architecture's one-way arrows point both ways — upward imports, a bus that cannot cross the process boundary, un-RFC'd cross-schema writes
themes.body: Doctrine states the boundaries clearly; the import graph violates them systemically. ~25 core/modules/jobs→butlers.api imports (each self-documented as circular-dependency avoidance) home the audit spine's canonical writer, pricing, and the conversation store in the interface layer. Worse, daemon-side emit_* calls publish session/spend/notification/approval events into in-process queues whose only subscribers live in the separate dashboard-api container — every daemon-originated live event is silently discarded while the Live indicator shows connected, masked only by polling. Framework code imports roster butlers via an import-time sys.modules hack with swallowed failures; the memory module UPDATEs/DELETEs chronicler's schema with no RFC; domain butlers bypass RFC 0011's 'unspoofable origin' MCP entry point by importing the switchboard broker in-process.
themes.exemplars: src/butlers/core/sessions.py:330 + docker-compose.yml:205-214 vs 548-551 (events die at the container boundary); src/butlers/core/audit.py:66-68 (audit writer homed in a FastAPI router); src/butlers/modules/memory/tools/entities.py:1112-1173 (cross-schema writes into chronicler)

themes.title: One fact, many numbers — displayed values computed from different sources than the enforced or adjacent ones
themes.body: The number the owner sees is repeatedly not the number the system acts on. /spend's MTD is priced from per-butler sessions fan-out while the spawn-deny gate prices public.token_usage_ledger (the dashboard can show 92% while spawns are already denied); the settings console reports rolling-30d under a 'Spend MTD' label and fires false ceiling alarms; sessions' cost column and dossier Token Usage silently exclude prompt-cache tokens and disagree with the Spend page to the cent; the board cell and the detail Overview show two different 'sessions 24h' computed by different SQL; ingestion's 'events · today' means trailing-24h on the roster and calendar-day heartbeat deltas on detail; per-rule 'Saved 7d' credits fleet-wide model usage to individual rules. Each mismatch trains the owner to distrust both copies.

themes.title: Governance stalls at the last step — merged ≠ archived ≠ deployed ≠ decided
themes.body: Every lifecycle in the project runs hot until its close-out step, then stops. Merged code is not deployed: core_155..161 sit dark in prod (attention ledger, owner-outbound events, discretion classification) behind an artisanal deploy with no drift surface, while the migrations one-shot exits 0 against a stale image. Shipped OpenSpec changes are not archived: switchboard-rule-promotion shows 0/25 tasks with 5/7 beads merged, leaving core-notify and ingestion-policy main specs materially false. Normative contracts accrete in AGENTS.md (~150 '<X> contract' notes) instead of specs. And owner decisions have no cadence: 14 decision beads wait invisibly — a P1 silent-message-loss fix has been blocked on a one-line choice since 07-05, and the deploy itself is one of the ungated decisions. The fix is procedural hooks (epic-close archives, deploy ledger, decision desk), not more sweeps.
themes.exemplars: bd bu-zhfd0 (7-revision gap, migrations exit 0 stale); openspec/changes/switchboard-rule-promotion/tasks.md (0/25 vs merged PRs #2992/#2999/#3015) + openspec/specs/core-notify/spec.md:17 vs src/butlers/core_tools/_notifications.py:227-238; AGENTS.md:816-872 (~150 contract notes)

themes.title: Cruft regrows faster than manual sweeps — dead code, dead endpoints, and duplicated utilities with no automated gate
themes.body: The closed cruft epic's debt fully regrew within weeks because only manual passes exist. ~3,000+ lines of orphaned frontend production code (retired relationship UI trio, pre-One-Spend costs pair, six dead hooks with full API verticals), seven duplicated passport atom files whose tests pin non-shipping copies (green tests over dead code), nine orphaned approvals hooks, three consumer-less backend WS routes kept 'for other clients' that don't exist, 13 private formatDuration and 4 formatCost clones despite lib/format-cost.ts documenting the exact bug the duplication reintroduces, and live deprecation shims with zero remaining producers. A knip-style import-graph CI gate plus delete-on-migration discipline converts this from a recurring epic into a build failure.

ranked_moves.title: Cross-process event transport + dead WS route deletion + bus-aware polls
ranked_moves.what: Add a Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY publisher in core so daemon-originated session/spend/notification/approval events actually reach the dashboard-api bus (today they die in in-process queues in another container); delete the ~25 upward emit imports and the three consumer-less legacy WS routes; add useBusAwarePollInterval so bus-covered queries tighten to a fast fallback when the socket drops (notifications gains its missing reconcile floor) and the pre-bus AutoRefreshToggle/fast floors retire.
ranked_moves.why: Earned calm + zero-cruft doctrine: the Live indicator shows connected while every daemon-originated event is silently discarded at the container boundary (failure impersonating liveness, masked by polling), a dead socket means 5-minute-to-infinite staleness with no adaptation, and three orphaned WS routes are maintained for clients that do not exist.
ranked_moves.evidence: src/butlers/core/sessions.py:330 + src/butlers/core/spawner.py:2237-2260 (emit into in-process queues) vs docker-compose.yml:205-214/548-551 (separate containers); approvals.py:2363-2375, spend.py:139, settings_console.py:653-702 (zero consumers, grep-proven); frontend/src/hooks/use-notifications.ts (no refetchInterval); event-bus.tsx:60-135 (status consumed only by RootLayout)
ranked_moves.slices: 1) NOTIFY publisher + API-side LISTEN bridge + two-pool integration test proving daemon→subscriber delivery; 2) delete daemon→api imports and the three WS routes + tests/spec refs; 3) useBusAwarePollInterval + adoption across the 8 bus-covered hooks + AutoRefreshToggle deletion; 4) coverage-manifest gaps (session-stripe, spend breakdown/rules/forecast keys).
